QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Three Keys
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.1:
The three keys have been gathered. Treglow's Key, Victor's Key, and the final one is Edea's Key. Edea was the last remaining guardian. 

While Edea tried to combine the keys, you received news that Piston was injured. It was #rVelderoth#k who attacked Piston...
QuestInfo.2: Edea advised you to take care of the matter with Velderoth first.
